notes: SoftBank Group calls the year ended March 31, 2025 'FY2024' (matches data.js fy 'Mar 2025'). Sources are SBG's own Annual Report 2025 (stock information) and Financial Report 2025 (audited IFRS consolidated statements), both on group.softbank; figures in millions of yen converted to billions. OWNERSHIP: 29.68% is the figure SBG attributes to Son. It excludes treasury stock from the denominator, and SBG aggregates the shares Son effectively holds by name. SON CORPORATION LLC (19,060 thousand shares, 1.33%) and Son Assets Management, LLC (18,504 thousand shares, 1.29%) appear as separate lines. The report does not say whether they are part of his 29.68%, and they are not added here or listed as other holders. LARGEST HOLDERS: The Master Trust Bank of Japan (Trust Account, 17.15%) and Custody Bank of Japan (Trust Account, 7.18%) are left out. SBG notes that their shares 'are all related to trust operations'. Custodian accounts (JP Morgan Chase Bank 380763 2.02%, HSBC Hong Kong 1.80%, two State Street accounts 1.31% and 1.23%) are left out for the same reason: none of these are beneficial owners. The Government of Norway (1.12%) is the only other top-10 holder named as a beneficial owner. DIVIDENDS are 'Cash dividends paid' by SBG (¥44 per share for the year). They exclude ¥368,678m of dividends paid to non-controlling interests by SoftBank Corp., LY Corporation and other subsidiaries, and ¥18,867m of 'Distribution to owners of other equity instruments' (hybrid instruments). BUYBACKS are 'Purchase of treasury stock' (¥237,058m). The Annual Report MD&A says SBG acquired 28,812,200 of its own shares for ¥237,045 million under the August 7, 2024 Board resolution. Purchases of subsidiary shares from non-controlling interests (¥79,581m) are excluded. STOCK COMP is the Group total, equity-settled plus cash-settled, and includes the RSU plans of subsidiaries such as Arm.
